candidate.hypothesis: A single operation-aware memory path should produce positive task-success uplift in both clean adjacent-operation recall and distractor-heavy longitudinal operation reasoning when subject identity is kept independent across tracks. Separately, explicit A-D query options and JSON answer contracts can be decoded deterministically without gold to prevent exact-match formatting failures observed in v9.
candidate.retrieval: Frozen v9 operation-aware query-sliced shadow retrieval: filter raw dialogues for explicit memory operations, preserve tombstones, zero source-recency weight, maximum twenty candidates, atomic event batch, and no production promotion.

strict_output_decoder.input: query text and treatment model output only
strict_output_decoder.option_scope: only A-D options following the final Now Answer the Question marker
strict_output_decoder.accepted_model_shape: valid JSON object with a string answer field, or a direct option string
strict_output_decoder.action: emit the exact query-provided option when its label or normalized text matches; otherwise retain the model output

memops_tracks.adjacent_operation: Candidate retrieval over the clean per-file session corpus versus no-memory control, scored by the pinned official MemOps answer evaluator.
memops_tracks.longitudinal_operation: Candidate retrieval over the distractor-injected longitudinal corpus versus no-memory control, scored by the pinned official MemOps answer evaluator.

development_firewall.allowed: Opened development evidence plus only MemOps subjects marked development in the pinned split manifest.
forbidden: all MemoryAgentBench validation and final units
all MemOps validation and final subjects
reuse of any v7-v9 opened development subject or context in the v10 gate

terminal_rule: Any failed development or admission gate is retained as failed_experiment_v10 or failed_admission_v10. Thresholds may not be relaxed and opened held-out evidence may never become tuning data.
claim_boundary: Only a full exact-SHA admission pass permits a bounded benchmark claim. SOTA, universal superiority, production promotion, replacement, 100%-pass, and revolutionary claims remain forbidden without separate external evidence.
